justification: The exact package in `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/contexts` contains 37 Java classes totaling 5,322 LOC. I inspected `AbstractJavaParserContext.java`, `StatementContext.java`, `ExpressionContext.java`, `JavaParserTypeDeclarationAdapter.java`, `ContextHelper.java`, and the concrete contexts such as `MethodCallExprContext.java`, `CompilationUnitContext.java`, `ClassOrInterfaceDeclarationContext.java`, `IfStatementContext.java`, `LambdaExprContext.java`, `RecordDeclarationContext.java`, and `AnnotationDeclarationContext.java`. These files show the package centralizes symbol-resolution logic for many unrelated AST areas (methods, constructors, classes/interfaces, enums, records, annotations, statements, expressions, and helper/adapter logic), which is strong evidence of a God Component.
